servicesFonctions.title: Why choose Mon Toubib?
servicesFonctions.subtitle: Mon Toubib is an e-health solution that can be deployed to improve access to care, strengthen medical coordination and facilitate patient journey management in different healthcare environments.
servicesFonctions.text3: Flexible, scalable and compliant with Moroccan regulatory requirements, it adapts to the needs of individuals, healthcare professionals, businesses and institutions alike. Our approach is based on a configurable architecture compliant with current legal frameworks (CNDP, DGSSI, ISO standards), enabling deployment adapted to each use context — private, public or institutional.

ecosysteme.subtitle: A complete, integrated and interoperable e-health ecosystem
ecosysteme.subtitle2: Key modules of the Mon Toubib platform
ecosysteme.description: Mon Toubib presents itself as a structured digital ecosystem that can connect all care pathway actors around a central core: the Shared Health Profile Record (DPSP). Each module responds to a specific need — prevention, diagnosis, coordination, follow-up, teleconsultation and practice management — while remaining interconnected. This architecture ensures fluid, secure, traceable care compliant with Moroccan and international standards.
ecosysteme.d2: All Mon Toubib modules communicate with each other around the DPSP, with fine-grained permission management driven by the doctor. Together they form a unified, secure and interoperable architecture (HL7, FHIR, ISO 13606, ISO 27001/27701/27799).
ecosysteme.d3: Mon Toubib aims to bring together the tools, data, access rights and actors of the healthcare system to contribute to a more unified, simpler and more secure medical experience for citizens. Mon Toubib positions itself as more than just a medical record: a new way to connect patients, professionals and technology, in service of modern and inclusive Moroccan healthcare.

dpsp.name: DPSP — Shared Health Profile Record
dpsp.description:
The DPSP is the nerve center of the system. It gathers the patient's complete medical history: history, allergies, imaging, treatments, test results, reports, prescriptions and closed FCIs. It is automatically updated with each validation of an Intelligent Consultation Form (FCI). The doctor precisely configures access permissions:
  • • Visibility for the patient
  • • Visibility for colleagues
  • • Visibility for other healthcare professionals
  • • Restrictions according to clinical context and medical confidentiality

fci.name: FCI — Intelligent Consultation Forms
fci.description: The FCI is a structured clinical tool allowing the doctor to conduct a complete consultation, assisted by AI. It can be pre-filled from the DPSP and information from the CSP. Once closed, the FCI is locked, timestamped and automatically integrated into the DPSP. The doctor determines which sections will be visible or not to the patient or other doctors.

csp.name: CSP — Personal Health Notebook (patient)
csp.description: Patient's private space to manage: personal parameters, health journal, wellness, reminders, vaccinations, daily measurements. The patient chooses what to share with their doctor. Some elements can feed the DPSP with explicit consent.

dispo.name: Dispo+: Teleconsultation & immediate availability
dispo.description: Allows the doctor to activate their real-time availability. The patient instantly sees if the doctor is available, busy or ready to receive a consultation. Each teleconsultation automatically generates an FCI and updates the DPSP.

ia.name: Health AI — Patients & Doctors
ia.description:
Two dedicated assistants:
  • • Health AI Patients: helps express symptoms, clarify the reason for visit, prepare the consultation.
  • • Health AI Doctors: intelligent voice dictation, clinical reformulation, structuring of observations in the FCI.

mrss.description:
• • MRSS Pro: reserved for doctors and authorized professionals, for clinical exchanges and best practices.

cmc.name: CMC — Connected Medical Cabins
cmc.description: E-health cabins for rural areas, industrial sites and remote regions. Based on connected sensors, trained agents and direct connection to MTS Doctor.

mts.name: MTS Doctor — Practice Management & Medical Activity
mts.description:
Web & mobile (responsive) solution allowing the doctor to manage all their activity:
  • • complete access to the DPSP
  • • access and management of FCIs
  • • management of immediate and scheduled consultations
  • • setting time slots
  • • shared calendar synchronized with assistants & patients
  • • management of medical assistants
  • • internal messaging
  • • management of additional services (procedures, services, prices, family discounts)
  • • automatic clinical notifications
MTS Doctor also allows the doctor to define all visibility permissions for the DPSP and FCIs. The platform is accessible 24/7, from the practice, clinic or smartphone, in strict compliance with CNDP, DGSSI and international security standards.

security.subtitle: Your data protected, here in Morocco when required
security.description:
Security, confidentiality and digital sovereignty are at the heart of Mon Toubib's architecture.
In accordance with CNDP and DGSSI guidelines, Mon Toubib strictly applies Moroccan laws regarding data protection, cybersecurity and confidentiality. Hosting and data processing choices are defined respecting the applicable regulatory framework and international standards for security and health data protection.
Each consultation, transaction or document benefits from systematic encryption, enhanced authentication and complete traceability, thanks to an advanced electronic signature architecture natively integrated into the platform.

decouvrirPlatform.description1:
Mon Toubib is much more than a website or an application: it is a sovereign e-health ecosystem, developed in Morocco, designed to connect all healthcare actors — patients, professionals, establishments and public institutions — around a secure and coordinated care pathway.
For healthcare professionals, the platform notably integrates an intelligent shared calendar, online appointment booking with mandatory payment, as well as structured management of patients and access rights.

dpsp.title: DPSP: Shared Patient Health Record
dpsp.description: The Shared Health Profile Record (DPSP) constitutes the continuity foundation of the Mon Toubib ecosystem. It centralizes, in a secure and interoperable manner, medical information validated by healthcare professionals — history, prescriptions, test results, imaging, reports and follow-ups — while strictly respecting access, traceability and confidentiality rules. The DPSP is fed from Intelligent Consultation Forms (FCI) and authorized business flows. The doctor remains master of the data they produce and decides, via sharing parameters, information made accessible to other authorized actors. The patient has consultation access, allowing them to verify the content of their record and ensure its transparency, in a relationship based on trust. The platform is designed to be deployed on infrastructures located in Morocco when this is required, or on environments compliant with applicable international standards, according to the regulatory and contractual framework of partners.

Thanks to Health AI and integrated support tools, the CSP helps the patient better understand their data, structure their questions, and become an informed actor in their care pathway, within a strictly confidential framework.

fci.title: FCI: Intelligent Consultation Forms
fci.description:
The Intelligent Consultation Forms (FCI) constitute a central working tool for doctors and healthcare professionals using the Mon Toubib platform. They allow structuring, documenting and securing medical consultations, while ensuring consistency of produced information and its traceability. FCIs integrate voice transcription and Health AI assistance tools, available in both MTS Doctor and MTS Patient. These tools have no diagnostic purpose: they help with reformulation and content structuring,
• in structured medical language for healthcare professionals,
• in clear and understandable language for patients, to facilitate exchange with the doctor.
Each validated FCI is electronically signed and feeds the Shared Patient Health Record (DPSP) according to sharing rules defined by the practitioner.

securityandebergement.subtitle: MTS Electronic Signature & Hosting — The foundations of digital trust
securityandebergement.description: The MTS Electronic Signature and data hosting mechanisms constitute structuring elements of the Mon Toubib platform. They guarantee user authenticity, document integrity, action traceability and regulatory compliance of all digital exchanges. Mon Toubib relies on a proprietary system of unique identifiers with control key, used for identification of persons, documents, medical acts and, where applicable, connected equipment. This device constitutes the foundation of the MTS Electronic Signature, natively integrated into the platform and independent of e-signature solutions proposed by third-party companies. Resort to an external electronic signature solution is only considered if required by a competent authority, particularly CNDP, or within specific regulatory or contractual requirements.

securityAndConformite.title: Security & Compliance
securityAndConformite.subtitle: Security & Compliance — A protected and certified digital health
securityAndConformite.description: Security and regulatory compliance constitute structuring principles of the Mon Toubib platform. Data, consultations and documents exchanged via the platform are protected by technical and organizational devices designed to be compliant with applicable national laws (09-08, 05-20, 43-20, 53-05) as well as recognized international standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 27799, HL7, FHIR). This approach guarantees enhanced protection of health data, complete traceability thanks to the unique identifier with control key, as well as an MTS Electronic Signature, compliant with law 43-20, ensuring integrity, authenticity and non-repudiation of each medical document. The platform is designed to be deployed on infrastructures compliant with applicable security and data protection standards. When required, particularly in response to regulatory, institutional or contractual requirements (CNDP, DGSSI, public organisms or large accounts), hosting on infrastructure located in Morocco can be established, in accordance with current legal framework. Mon Toubib thus places compliance, transparency and digital security at the service of trust between citizens, healthcare professionals and institutions.

rows.commitment1: Adaptable architecture allowing, when required, deployment on data centers located in Morocco or on environments compliant with international security standards.
rows.commitment2: Privacy policy compliant with Law 09-08, access control, data encryption and regular security audits.
rows.commitment3: Each document is signed via a unique identifier associated with a Mod-97 control key, guaranteeing integrity and traceability, without systematic dependence on e-signature third parties.
rows.commitment4: Automatic action logging, timestamping and auditability of operations.
rows.commitment5: Structured data exchange between DPSP, FCI and CSP modules according to international standards.
rows.commitment6: Implementation of cybersecurity measures provided by law 05-20: SSI governance, incident management and internal supervision.

securityAndConformite.d2: These guarantees are integrated from design (« Security by Design ») and applied by default («Security by Default »). "Compliance is not an option, it is our foundation. Mon Toubib is part of a responsible, ethical digital health approach strictly aligned with requirements of the Moroccan legal framework." — ASI Maroc SARL
securityAndConformite.p: Mon Toubib is part of a responsible digital health approach. The platform is designed to operate respecting applicable regulatory framework, recognized security standards and data protection requirements. A lasting trust base for citizens and healthcare professionals.

help.title: Mon Toubib Help and Frequently Asked Questions

section1.title: Overview of Mon Toubib
section1.answer: Mon Toubib is an integrated e-health platform, designed to improve access to care, medical coordination, and management of health information, in a secure digital environment compliant with regulatory requirements. It allows connecting patients, health professionals, and medical structures around reliable, advanced digital tools focused on user experience.
section1.answer2:
• Facilitate access to health services
• Improve coordination between medical actors
• Simplify management of appointments and health information
• Promote continuity of care
• Ensure security and confidentiality of data

section2.title: User profiles and roles
section2.answer:
The platform is accessible to several user categories:
• Patients
• Health professionals (doctors, paramedics, structures)
• Institutions and organizations (depending on activated services)
Each profile benefits from functions tailored to their role and needs.
section2.answer2: No. Services accessible depend on the user profile, granted permissions, and modules activated on the platform. Each profile benefits from functions tailored to their role and needs.

section3.title: Account creation and access
section3.question1: How do I create a Mon Toubib account?
section3.answer:
Account creation is done via:
• The mobile application,
• Or the Mon Toubib website.
The process varies depending on the profile (patient or professional) and may include verification or accreditation steps.
section3.question2: Can I modify or update my information?
section3.answer2: Yes. Each user can update their personal information from their secure space, within the limits set by the platform.

section4.title: Using Mon Toubib services
section4.question1: How do I book, modify, or cancel an appointment?
section4.answer: Patients can consult professional availability and manage their appointments directly via the platform, according to options offered by the health professional.
section4.question2: Can I consult my health information?
section4.answer2:
Access to health information depends on:
• Data shared by professionals,
• Permissions defined by the patient,
• And activated functions.
section4.answer3: Yes, within a secure and controlled framework, respecting access rules, confidentiality, and patient choices.

section5.title: Personal data, confidentiality, and security (user level)
section5.answer: Mon Toubib implements security measures aimed at protecting personal and health data from unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.
section5.answer2:
Access is strictly limited:
• To authorized persons,
• According to defined role and rights,
• And in accordance with options expressed by the user.
section5.question3: Where can I find detailed commitments?
section5.answer3:
Complete information regarding data protection is available in:
• The Legal and Compliance Documents page,
• Privacy policy.

section6.title: Help, support, and accompaniment
section6.question1: How do I contact Mon Toubib help?
section6.answer:
Help service accessible via:
• A dedicated contact form,
• Or support channels indicated on the platform.
section6.question2: What types of requests can be handled?
section6.answer2:
• Help using the platform
• Access or account problems
• General questions about services
• Report anomalies
section6.answer3: Requests are handled within timeframes adapted to their nature, with priority given to critical topics.

compliance.desc1: Present in a clear and institutional manner the comprehensive approach to Mon Toubib's digital security, to reassure users, partners, and authorities about risk control, system protection, and regulatory compliance, without entering into a legal register.
compliance.desc2: At Mon Toubib, digital security constitutes a fundamental pillar of the platform. It is not limited to data protection, but encompasses all technical, organizational, and operational devices aimed at ensuring the reliability, availability, and integrity of proposed e-health services. This comprehensive approach allows ensuring a trusted digital environment, adapted to the specific requirements of the health sector.
compliance.desc3: The Mon Toubib platform was designed according to the principle of security by design. Each component — web applications, mobile applications, and infrastructures — integrates protection mechanisms from the earliest development stages. This approach allows anticipating risks, reducing structural vulnerabilities, and ensuring controlled evolution of the system over time.
compliance.desc4: Mon Toubib gives particular attention to protecting health data and respecting users' privacy. Data is processed in a secure, confidential manner compliant with applicable regulatory requirements in Morocco. Precise processing methods, retention, and user rights are detailed in the Legal and Compliance Documents and Privacy Policy pages, accessible from the site.
compliance.desc5: Access to Mon Toubib services is strictly controlled with mechanisms adapted to user roles (patients, health professionals, institutions). Traceability devices record access and sensitive actions, contributing to preventing unauthorized uses, detecting incidents, and respecting accountability and transparency obligations.
compliance.desc6: The platform relies on hosting infrastructures that respond to security, availability, and service continuity requirements. Mon Toubib implements backup, redundancy, and activity resumption mechanisms to ensure system resilience in the face of technical or operational incidents, while ensuring protection of hosted data.
compliance.desc7: Mon Toubib's digital security is part of an organized and evolving governance approach. Existing devices are regularly evaluated and adapted to take into account the evolution of risks, regulatory requirements, and best practices of the e-health sector. The logic of continuous improvement allows Mon Toubib to maintain a high level of security over the long term.
compliance.desc8: For more information on Mon Toubib's legal, regulatory, and compliance commitments, please consult the Legal and Compliance Documents page.
compliance.title10: Mon Toubib compliance and legal framework
compliance.d1: Present the regulatory, legal, and governance framework in which Mon Toubib operates, to demonstrate the platform's compliance with applicable legal requirements in Morocco and international best practices for the e-health sector.
compliance.d2: Mon Toubib operates within a precise legal and regulatory framework, adapted to digital health issues. The platform is designed to operate respecting applicable laws, while integrating principles of responsible and transparent governance. This approach aims to ensure the trust of users, health professionals, and institutional partners.
compliance.d3: Mon Toubib respects applicable Moroccan regulations for digital services and protection of personal data, under the authority of competent bodies. Data processing implemented by the platform is designed to be compliant with legal requirements, particularly in terms of purpose, security, confidentiality, and rights of concerned persons.
compliance.d4: Health data processed via Mon Toubib receives particular attention, given its sensitive nature. The platform puts in place regulatory and technical mechanisms aimed at ensuring responsible data processing, limiting access to authorized persons, and use compatible with medical purposes or care coordination.
compliance.d5: Relations between Mon Toubib, health professionals, and partners are organized by clear contractual agreements, defining the responsibilities of each party. Partnerships presented on the platform are exclusively those that were the subject of formal agreements, according to principles of transparency and compliance.
compliance.d6: Mon Toubib gives particular importance to informing users about the platform's operation and processing of their data. Legal documents and regulatory information are accessible in a clear and organized manner, allowing each user to understand their rights and Mon Toubib's commitments.
compliance.d7: The legal and regulatory framework for digital health evolves regularly. Mon Toubib adopts a continuous adaptation approach to anticipate and integrate legal, normative, and sectoral developments. This permanent monitoring contributes to maintaining a high level of compliance over the long term.
compliance.d8: Details relating to user rights, data processing, and legal obligations are detailed in the Legal and Compliance Documents page as well as in the Privacy Policy.
